column1: # /Graph Options Data-Labels {A-F} placement — after the POINT
# Below) pops to record where each label sits relative to its
# Slice F (data-labels placement) of GRAPH_PLAN.md. Until this
# slice the per-series data-label range was stored but no
# placement metadata existed; the placement submenu is the
# follow-up step the original /GOD path asks. Default placement
# Defaults: every slot's placement is Above.
# Seed A1..A3 = Q1..Q3 so the data-label POINT has cells to bind.
# /GOD A — range A1..A3 then placement Center.
# /GOD B — bind B at the same range, placement Below.
